args.title: Remember the last-used export format in the browser
args.body:
File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

ExportButton currently always initializes its format select to the `defaultFormat` prop, which defaults to "csv", with no persistence. Change it to read the last-used format from localStorage on mount (falling back to the current default when nothing is stored) and write the chosen format to localStorage whenever the user changes the select, so the format is remembered the next time the report is opened in the same browser.

This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

ExportButton always initializes its format select from the `defaultFormat` prop (which defaults to "csv") and never persists a user's choice. The fix is to have it read/write the last-used format to localStorage so it's remembered per-browser, as requested.
